name: Level Up Groovy
description: An ensemble for Level Up Groovy, the owner's own Suno piece, rebuilt one instrument at a time against its stems. Bass: Standard Bass DI in three layers - one centred and full range, and two copies high-passed at 180 Hz and panned apart, because the original's bass is near-mono at its fundamental and wide above it, which a plain double-track cannot do. Its Sub_Bass control is mapped, which is what undoes the library's own -12 dB at 64 Hz; left unmapped the bass has no bottom and no gain change will give it one. Synth line: HamOrg, drawbars set from the stem's harmonics (the note, its octave near level, a little of the next two), its rotary cabinet stopped so held notes stay level, and sent further into the hall than a lead usually is - the stem's line is wide, and a mono organ with a stopped rotor has no width of its own. Pad and choir: two parts, a lane each - Veil holding the chord low and VPO's female choir singing it high, which is what the stem's side channel has. Kit: sm-drums, shaped.
